overview: LegalFlow is a modern SaaS platform for legal management, designed to centralize processes, clients, contracts, and finances for lawyers and law firms.

features.name: Clients Management
features.description: CRUD operations for PF/PJ clients with history and tenant isolation.

features.name: Process Management
features.description: Kanban board for legal processes with status tracking and urgency indicators.
critical_flows: Filter processes by tribunal or area

features.name: Financial Management
features.description: Income, expense, and profit tracking with automated PDF reports.

features.name: Authentication & Security
features.description: JWT-based auth with strict multi-tenancy and 2FA support.
